name: 48035 · Clinton Twp, MI
findings: ZIP 48035 (Clinton Twp) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48035 (Clinton Twp) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48035 (Clinton Twp) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
